channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: New Zealand-Pakistan Super Eight World Cup clash rained off
item.description: COLOMBO: The Super Eight clash between Pakistan and New Zealand in the Twenty20 World Cup was washed out without a ball being bowled after heavy rain in Colombo on Saturday.

item.title: [UPDATED] Bersatu drops Ronald Kiandee from PN Supreme Council slot
item.description: PETALING JAYA: Datuk Seri Dr Ronald Kiandee has been dropped as Bersatu’s representative in the Perikatan Nasional Supreme Council.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Jojie claims Ella's concert was sabotaged: 'There's CCTV evidence, we're investigating'
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The recent "Majlis Tertinggi Rockqueen Ella" concert, held on Feb 14 at the Bukit Jalil National Stadium, has been marred by allegations of sabotage following widespread complaints regarding poor sound quality on the third level of the venue.

item.title: Tragic sahur as fire razes four houses, leaves 21 homeless
item.description: KEPALA BATAS: Twenty-one villagers were left with only the clothes on their backs after their houses were destroyed in a fire at Kampung Permatang Kerai Besar here early today.

item.title: Late Turner try earns Scotland 26-23 comeback win in Wales
item.description: CARDIFF: A try five minutes from time by hooker George Turner secured Scotland a 26-23 bonus-point victory over Wales on Saturday, breaking the hearts of the home side who extended their losing run in the Six Nations Championship to 14 games.

item.title: Ragged England undone by Ireland's greater desire and intent
item.description: LONDON: England’s performance in their record 42-21 Twickenham thrashing by Ireland on Saturday was a combination of technical and tactical failures but the overriding feeling was that the visitors had showed more intent in everything they did.

item.title: PN leaders meet at Pas HQ to choose new chairman
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Several leaders of Perikatan Nasional (PN) component parties, including Gerakan president Dominic Lau, arrived at the Pas Headquarters on Jalan Raja Laut to attend the coalition's Supreme Council meeting this afternoon.

item.title: Bridgeman powers to six-shot lead over McIlroy at Riviera
item.description: LOS ANGELES: Jacob Bridgeman closed in on a first US PGA Tour title on Saturday, firing an impressive seven-under par 64 to take a six-stroke lead over world number two Rory McIlroy heading into the final round of the Genesis Invitational.

item.title: Klaebo makes Olympic history as Gu forced to wait
item.description: MILAN: Norwegian cross-country skier Johannes Klaebo won a ground-breaking sixth gold at the Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics on Saturday, while heavy snow forced China’s freestyle skiing superstar Eileen Gu to wait for her elusive first title in Italy.

item.title: Trump, once unstoppable, hits snag after snag ahead of major US address
item.description: FOR a year, Donald Trump has governed the United States with little standing in his way.
